articles.title: UK food supply chain affected by European freezer hacks, cyber chief says
articles.description: Supermarkets in countries including Ireland, Sweden and Belgium reported fridges being hiked in temperature on Monday.

articles.title: Plane may have broken apart ahead of deadly Florida jet crash, say investigators
articles.description: The National Transportation Safety Board also believes weather could have been a factor in the crash, but warns it is too early to determine the cause.

articles.title: If hackers can take control of a supermarket freezer, how vulnerable is other tech?
articles.description: Dozens of shops across European countries have been hit by a cyber-attack affecting their fridges.

articles.title: 'All this food is now useless': Piles of rubbish after shop freezers hit by cyber-attack
articles.description: Dozens of supermarkets in seven European countries dumped huge quantities of food after refrigerators and freezers were targeted in a cyber-attack.

articles.title: France launches attempted murder investigation after petrol bomb thrown at police
articles.description: There were hundreds of arrests as protesters took to the streets in cities across France for the third weekend in a row.
